description.p: RustChamber is a native desktop workspace for OpenCode written in Rust with egui. Chat, terminal, files, changes, and git live in the same window, with a keyboard-first interface built for long agent sessions.

ul.li: Streaming chat with Markdown, reasoning, tools, and permission prompts
Real PTY terminal with tabs, colors, and scrollback
Project tree, editor, session diffs, and native git operations
Managed OpenCode server lifecycle or an existing remote endpoint

description.p: Requires the OpenCode CLI and git on the host. The Flatpak runs those tools through the Flatpak spawn portal so the user's credentials, shell, and repositories remain available.

screenshot.caption: The new-session composer with a project or Chat target
Streaming chat with tools, reasoning, and session context
Native git panel with staged and unstaged changes

description.p: Portable Linux packages, Flatpak support, and desktop theme detection.
First Linux release with native packages and in-app updates.
